title: AIAS Enterprise Drawing Framework
purpose: Provide a canonical UI-independent engineering drawing model and deterministic portable vector outputs.
scope: Sheets, layers, lines, text, dimensions, views, scales, bounds, revisions, provenance, JSON, SVG, DXF, PDF, manifests and reference foundation sheet.

requirements.title: Canonical drawing model
requirements.statement: Drawings shall use stable entities, named layers, millimetre paper space, sheets, views, scales and provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Drawing validation
requirements.statement: The framework shall reject duplicate identity, unknown layers, unsafe text, invalid scales, out-of-bounds geometry and absent review boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Portable export
requirements.statement: Validated drawings shall export deterministically to JSON, SVG, DXF and vector PDF.
requirements.rationale: Support CAD, browser, archive and printable consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Release evidence
requirements.statement: Every exported format shall carry path, byte count and SHA-256 digest.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: A traceable A3 foundation plan shall render and preserve professional review status.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: The framework shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
